scripts.gen:observer: node scripts/run-wesley-tool.mjs host-node observer-plan --spec src/app/jedit-observer-spec.ts --export createWorldlineSnapshotObserverSpec --out-file src/generated/jedit/worldlineSnapshot.observer-plan.generated.ts
scripts.gen:contract:text-buffer-optic:wesley: node scripts/run-wesley-tool.mjs cli emit typescript --schema contracts/jedit/text-buffer-optic.graphql --out src/generated/jedit/text-buffer-optic.wesley.generated.ts
scripts.gen:contract:hot-text-runtime:wesley: node scripts/run-wesley-tool.mjs cli emit typescript --schema contracts/jedit/hot-text-runtime.graphql --out src/generated/jedit/hot-text-runtime.wesley.generated.ts
scripts.gen:contract:wesley: npm run gen:contract:hot-text-runtime:wesley && npm run gen:contract:structural-history:wesley
scripts.gen:contract:legacy: node scripts/run-wesley-tool.mjs host-node typescript --schema contracts/jedit/hot-text-runtime.graphql --out-file src/generated/jedit/hot-text-runtime.types.generated.ts && node scripts/run-wesley-tool.mjs host-node zod --schema contracts/jedit/hot-text-runtime.graphql --out-file src/generated/jedit/hot-text-runtime.zod.generated.ts
scripts.gen:contract: npm run gen:contract:wesley && npm run gen:contract:legacy && npm run gen:observer
scripts.build: npm run gen:contract:structural-history:wesley && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs
scripts.test: npm run gen:contract:structural-history:wesley && node --test --test-concurrency=1 spec/**/*.spec.mjs tests/**/*.spec.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test && npm run quality
